verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Treasury Prime serves an llms.txt at docs.treasuryprime.com, returning HTTP 200 with a structured index. The index links to markdown (.md) versions of the developer docs, and the other doc pages are also served as .md, so an agent can be pointed directly at them. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing agent-oriented usage (e.g., an llms-full.txt or AI/agent guidance page), independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.treasuryprime.com/llms.txt # Treasury Prime Developer Documentation
